title: Salvage Proceeds, Subrogation Recoveries and the Deductible
content:
**Clauses in force for the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision):**

1. Salvage proceeds and subrogation recoveries reduce the net loss paid.
2. A deductible reimbursement is made only after a subrogation recovery has been received on the claim. The claim payment records decide.
3. A salvage sale never returns any deductible.

**Clause no longer in force.** The former clause "The named insured's deductible is returned in proportion to the share of total damages (payments plus deductible) recovered, rounded to the cent, and in full when the recovery is full" is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis.

### Recovery types and their effect

| Recovery received on the claim | Reduces the net loss paid | Opens the way to a deductible reimbursement |
|---|---|---|
| Subrogation recovery from an at-fault party's insurer | Yes | Yes |
| Salvage proceeds from the sale of a total-loss vehicle | Yes | No, never |
| No recovery yet | Not applicable | No |

superseded_clauses: The named insured's deductible is returned in proportion to the share of total damages (payments plus deductible) recovered, rounded to the cent, and in full when the recovery is full;
